# mp18 (owner 23 Nov 'make sure multiplayer works'; ONE Vita): the on-hub route with TODAY's plan (fourth core on, LOCKED 60 hold, GT18, held governor). Besides the online rules: `[vita] core 3 rules: an online or LAN session is up: N thread(s) moved off the system core` when the online screens open (the online guard, np_vita_core3.h). Needs CapUnlocker (without it `fourth core: not available` and the guard line cannot appear: report, not a failure of multiplayer). PASS (tools/console-1.2/online_check.py <log> --run <id> reads it all): every STATE line of the route in order and `script exit`, no `[script] TIMEOUT`, no crash; the `[np-net] req` lines show every request ANSWERED by the service (an HTTP 2xx or the service's own JSON error with a code), no `trying the other address` line (either `[np-net]` or `[online]`: in an auto run one means the new address FAILED: report it), host=new on every request of an auto run, host=old in the old variant; at most 100 requests in any 10 s window (the zone's shared rule) and the requests per minute stay far below the service's daily budget; every pollScale / over_budget level / retryAfterSec the log shows is reported; the menu returns after the cancel. Needs a package built from agent/online24 (MSC_NET_REQLOG: before it the client logs no request line and the rules cannot be read).
